items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: So I liked it, and I got to know George Lewis rather well.

ctx.x: You were in one of them?

You could see me with my first wife, we were still going together. She’s sitting on my knee and we’re smiling listening to Bunk Johnson. It’s a marvelous thing. So I liked it, and I got to know George Lewis rather well. And he hated Bunk Johnson and the whole band hated Bunk. It was like — and George Lewis was such a gentle, sweet guy. But I remember we were in a men’s room once and Bunk’s name came up and he just — Bunk Johnson — you wouldn’t believe that George could get that nasty with those kind of words. I…
Well they were probably thrown together with him because he had so much hype going on, rediscovered, you know, working in the fields, and they got new teeth and all.
